inputs.name: playbook
inputs.value:
`---
- name: "Stage 1: Patch Canary Machines"
  hosts: canary
  gather_facts: yes
  vars:
    patch_data: ${JSON.stringify($patchesToApply)}
  tasks:
    - name: Print the current host
      debug:
        msg: "Running on host: {{ inventory_hostname }}"
        
    - name: Get patch commands for this host
      set_fact:
        current_host_advisories: "{{ patch_data[inventory_hostname] | default([]) }}"

    - name: Print advisories for this host
      debug:
        msg: "Advisory commands for this host: {{ current_host_advisories }}"

    - name: Apply patches and record success/failure
      shell: "{{ item }}"
      register: patch_result
      ignore_errors: yes
      become: yes
      loop: "{{ current_host_advisories }}"

    - name: Record successful patches
      set_fact:
        applied_advisories: "{{ applied_advisories | default([]) + [item.item] }}"
      when: item.rc == 0
      loop: "{{ patch_result.results }}"

    - name: Record failed patches
      debug:
        msg: "Patch command failed: {{ item.item }}"
      when: item.rc != 0
      loop: "{{ patch_result.results }}"

    - name: Reboot the host
      reboot:
        reboot_timeout: 300
      become: yes

    - name: Record applied advisories
      set_fact:
        patch_status:
          status: "success"
          applied_advisories: "{{ applied_advisories }}"

    - name: Final rescue block if anything failed above
      block:
        # (This block intentionally left empty or can have notifications/logging)
        - debug:
            msg: "All went well"
      rescue:
        - name: Set patch status on failure
          set_fact:
            patch_status:
              status: "failed"
              reason: "{{ ansible_failed_result.msg | default('Unknown error') }}"
              applied_advisories: []

- name: "Generate Patch Summary Report"
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: no
  tasks:
    - name: Generate patch summary dictionary
      set_fact:
        patch_summary: >-
          {{
            dict(
              hostvars
              | dict2items
              | selectattr('value.patch_status', 'defined')
              | map(attribute='key')
              | zip(
                  hostvars
                  | dict2items
                  | selectattr('value.patch_status', 'defined')
                  | map(attribute='value.patch_status')
                )
            )
          }}
    
    - name: Print patch summary
      debug:
        var: patch_summary


 
`

meta.description: This workflow automates the application of RHSA patches to Red Hat VMs. It extracts relevant advisories, applies patches via Ansible, and reboots the machines as needed.
